description: This Rust source file implements an asynchronous function to send emails via Gmail API, including helper functions for message creation and argument parsing, as well as unit tests.

methods.name: handle_send
methods.description: Asynchronously handles sending an email by constructing the message, obtaining OAuth token, and executing the Gmail API method.

methods.name: create_raw_message
methods.description: Creates a raw MIME email string with specified recipient, subject, and body.

methods.name: create_send_body
methods.description: Creates a JSON payload with the raw email message, encoding it with URL_SAFE.

methods.name: parse_send_args
methods.description: Parses command-line argument matches into a SendConfig struct.
